title: arxiv_1906.01760v3
universal_lens: Continuous-time stochastic valuation of American football outcomes via player-tracking data integration and recurrent neural network modeling. A continuous-time stochastic framework for American football valuation integrating player dynamics, play types, and real-time expectations via conditional expectations and probabilistic decision trees.
gsi_mapping: Bayesian inference over play-state likelihoods using conformal predictive distributions derived from tracked player dynamics and ball trajectories. Bayesian inference on play-state filtrations F(Xt,i) enables dynamic updates of expected yardage E[Y∗t,i|F(Xt,i)] using conformal prediction bounds for uncertainty quantification.
gse_mapping: Situational reasoning engine mapping real-time player positions and trajectories to dynamic expected points and win probability transitions through state-space Markov chains. Situation-aware state transitions model rushing vs. passing decisions through a decision tree with probabilistic nodes, updating internal states via ball-carrier expectation and play-type conditioning.

primitives.name: Continuous-Time Play Valuation Framework
primitives.verbatim_quote: In this work, we make two main contributions: First, we introduce a general framework for continuous-time within-play valuation in the National Football League using player-tracking data.

primitives.breakdown_regime: At discrete play boundaries or when tracking data becomes unavailable.

layer2.mapping: Maps tracking data to continuous-time stochastic processes via recurrent neural networks, enabling real-time E[t] estimation.

primitives.name: Ball-Carrier Trajectory Estimator
primitives.verbatim_quote: Second, we use a long short-term memory recurrent neural network to construct a ball-carrier model to estimate how many yards the ball-carrier is expected to gain from their current position, conditional on the locations and trajectories of the ball-carrier, their teammates and opponents.

primitives.assumptions: LSTM captures temporal dependencies in player movement; teammates and opponents influence ball-carrier path via spatial proximity.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When ball-carrier is out of bounds or tackled.

layer2.mapping: Generates conditional density estimates of future ball-carrier positions using LSTM-based RNNs trained on tracking data.

primitives.name: Conditional Density Estimation Module
primitives.verbatim_quote: Additionally, we demonstrate an extension with conditional density estimation so that the expectation of any measure of play value can be calculated in continuous-time, which was never before possible at such a granular level.
